# اُرْتُكِسَا (urtukisā) /ur.tu.ki.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# اِرْتَكِسَا (irtakisā) /ir.ta.ki.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
